rules: Primary goal is verified net earnings credited/earned in the owner's controlled seller/creator/platform balance, after platform commission and attributable runtime/payment costs.
Pending authorisations, unsettled customer payments, free credits, promo credits, self-purchases, disputed, restricted or forfeitable balances are not counted in primary earnings.
Record platform_credited, restricted_or_held, withdrawable and bank_settled as separate states.
A withdrawal from a platform balance to bank is a transfer, not new revenue; never count the same sale twice.
Subtract refunds, reversals, chargebacks, platform commission, payment processing and attributable runtime/storage/proxy costs.
For non-INR earnings, retain source currency, amount, FX rate, source and timestamp when expressing INR.
Tax optimisation and payout-method optimisation are deferred, but mandatory platform eligibility, identity and contractual conditions must not be bypassed.
